models.settings.title: Models
models.settings.desc: The full catalog, the recommendation for this PC, downloads, delete and switch.
models.first.title: Your PC, analyzed
models.first.lead: hivedesk runs an AI model on this computer. This is what it found and what it suggests. Nothing is downloaded until you choose.
models.hw.title: Detected hardware
models.hw.cpuOnly: CPU only: models run slower, so smaller ones are suggested.
models.where.partial: {share}% on the GPU, the rest on the CPU
models.q.note: Quality is a heuristic from published benchmarks, not a measurement.
models.why.fitsGpu: {model} fits in the {vram} with a {ctx} token context
models.why.unified: {model} fits in the unified memory with a {ctx} token context
models.why.partial: {share}% of {model} fits on the GPU; the rest runs on the CPU, slower
models.why.cpu: {model} runs on the CPU ({cores} cores, {ram} RAM)
models.why.measured: speed measured on this kind of PC
models.license.accept: Downloading means you accept this license.
models.later.note: Nothing was downloaded. Open Settings, Models when you want a model, or use Ollama, LM Studio or a cloud key.
models.dl.title: Downloading {model}
models.dl.resume: You can close this window: the download goes on, and a cut download resumes where it stopped.
models.dl.verify: Every file is checked against its published SHA-256 before it is used.
models.consent.title: Download this model?
models.consent.lead: hivedesk needs your yes before it downloads anything.
models.giant.meter: Needs {need} of memory. Your city has {have} (this PC plus what friends share). {missing} missing: invite {lo} to {hi} more friends with a GPU.
models.giant.meterFits: Needs {need} of memory. Your city has {have}: enough memory is pooled.
models.giant.label: VRAM + shared RAM
models.giant.nobody: No friend shares a GPU or CPU with you yet. Friends turn sharing on themselves, with their own limits, and can stop it at any time.
models.giant.unlocked: Enough memory is pooled for this session.
models.giant.speed: Estimated speed across the city: {tps} tokens/s
models.giant.tooSlow: The pooled memory fits, but the estimate is under 1 token per second: too slow to unlock.
models.giant.lan: This works well on the same local network.
models.giant.internet: Over the internet this is slow: every token waits for each friend's PC, and the weights travel to them once at load.
models.giant.ramNote: Shared RAM can hold layers too, but CPU workers are much slower than GPUs, so they count fully for memory and slowly for speed.
models.giant.experimental: Running one model across several PCs is experimental and off. Turn it on in Sharing; it runs over the encrypted session with friends who granted you compute.pool and GPU or CPU.
models.err.demo: Models are not available in demo mode.
models.sort.name: Name
models.giant.experimentalOn: Pooled models are on (experimental). Friends compute part of every answer, so tool calls from a pooled model always wait for you.
models.rot.autoDesc: For every turn, pick the installed model that fits the role and the task best.
models.rot.residentDesc: More loaded models switch faster but use more VRAM and RAM.
models.rot.noBrain: The router starts with the first local model.
models.share.lead: Lend this PC to friends for giant models. GPU and CPU are separate, both off until you turn them on, each with its own limits. Only the friends you list get a lease, it ends on time, and you can revoke it at any moment.
models.share.gpuDesc: Friends can use up to this much VRAM for layers of their model.
models.share.cpuDesc: Friends can use these threads and this much RAM. Much slower than a GPU.
models.share.peersDesc: Peer ids, separated by commas. Nobody else gets a lease.
models.share.experimentalDesc: Off by default. Uses llama.cpp RPC: this PC loads the model and friends compute some of its layers.
models.share.buildDesc: The official llama.cpp build, checked with SHA-256, from {source}. Downloaded only when you press Install.
models.share.honest: Same network: works well. Internet: slow, every token waits for each friend, and the first load sends them the weights. A friend's PC computes part of every answer, so tool calls from a pooled model always wait for you.
models.giant.runNote: The first load sends each friend their part of the weights.
models.giant.loading: Asking your friends for their leases and loading the model.
